AGENTS.md.summary: Monorepo root: Next.js webapp (frontend+REST API), BullMQ workers, Postgres/Redis, pnpm workspaces; rules: change code in smallest dir whose AGENTS.md covers feature; cross-cutting changes touch packages/shared (contract) and often packages/scan-core; DB changes via packages/db migrations; commands pnpm lint/typecheck/test; no comments unless requested.

docs/AGENTS.md.summary: Docs conventions: Dutch docs, FEATURES.md canonical numbering (renumbering forbidden), plan status flow (plan → 📝 → 🚧 → ✅); plans point to packages/shared schemas instead of duplicating contracts.

apps/web/AGENTS.md.summary: Next.js frontend + REST API routes: route table, auth/roles, credit enforcement, SSE contract, enqueue-only scan start.

apps/worker/AGENTS.md.summary: BullMQ workers: dispatcher fan-out, check catalog, aggregator/scoring, retry/timeout, Redis locks, checks-tabel, uptime poller.

packages/shared/AGENTS.md.summary: Single source of truth: check catalog, zod schemas (progress, findings, events), enums, scoring types, pure progress-math.

packages/scan-core/AGENTS.md.summary: Shared scan-lifecycle DB-helpers (web + worker): finishScan, setSiteScanState, atomic progress, credits, notifications, dispatcher-enqueue.

docs/FEATURES.md.summary: Canonical feature list with numbers, MVP flags, statuses; plan mapping column.

docs/ROADMAP.md.summary: Phases 0-6 with klaar-als criteria; plan-overzicht table.

docs/plans/02-team-invites.md.summary: Teams + memberships + rollen; invite-route. Seat-check must be added here (plan 64 step 2).

docs/plans/03-pricing-stripe-credits.md.summary: Billing + plan-limits; feature-flags seats + white_label on Max-plan (feature 3).

docs/plans/10-export.md.summary: Export PDF/MD renderer — must read branding tokens (plan 64 step 3 extension).

docs/plans/16-billing-admin.md.summary: Settings + subscription management; branding settings UI lives in settings (plan 64 decision 2).

docs/plans/57-public-status-page.md.summary: Public status page precedent: public route pattern, noindex, rate limit — reference for portal (plan 64 step 5).
